Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ 20 sec continuously'): encoded as charFixes.burstCooldownSec 20 — the engine's channel for 'this unit's burst cooldown IS N seconds' (prepare.ts subtracts CDR from the charFixes-corrected CD; it is the ONLY permanent-CD hook). CLAUSE→CHANNEL: 'continuously' = EVERY 40s cycle is 20s shorter (effective 20s cadence), which a burstCdr block CANNOT express — burstCdr refunds REMAINING burstCdFrames once per block firing (a passive-triggered burstCdr fires exactly once at frame 0, accelerating only the first cast: the oncePerBattle-shaped misread the S2b reviewer flagged as nearest-wrong), and a burstCast-keyed self-refund would be a fabricated re-trigger the kit never describes. 'Activates at the start of battle' is trivially satisfied: the lowered CD is live from frame 0. Self-only by construction (a prepared-unit field, never touches teammates). Observable: her burst cadence — every inter-cast gap < 20s (vs all gaps > 20s un-treasured). This is the kit's meta-defining lever: a 20s-cadence Burst I. K3 (S2a, 'Activates when above 80% HP'): Critical Damage ▲11.13% 'continuously' → passive → allies (all, incl. self) → critDamagePct 11.13, NO durationSec (continuous). The >80% HP gate is trivially always-true in v1: no HP pool, the boss deals no damage, milk sits at 100% HP the whole fight — always-on is the faithful collapse, not a drop (mast's HP<70% always-on precedent; S2b concurs). Generic critDamagePct (not critRate, not normal-scoped — the prose has no qualifier). K4 (S2b, 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge for 10 time(s)'): all allies Burst CD ▼2.83s → chargeCounter count:10 (scalar = same threshold every phase, so it fires EVERY 10th full charge, cycling — the kit attaches no once-per-battle clause) → allies → burstCdr 2.83 (instant refund of remaining CD, no event emitted; observable as accelerated team burst cadence). TRIGGER IDENTITY: chargeCounter, not hitCount — the prose says 'with Full Charge'. Honest residual: the engine's SR auto-play fires EVERY pull as a full charge, so a hitCount:10 counter would be observationally identical on this unit TODAY; the identity is pinned by the encoding (S5/S6 re-derive it) and bites only if a future engine path adds uncharged SR shots (S2b's concern). 'All allies' INCLUDES milk — she accelerates herself too. K5 (BUa, 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF'): 367.34% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage → burstCast → enemy → flatDamage 367.34 (burst bucket). 'Highest final DEF' is trivially the partless solo boss. FB-EXEMPT by cast timing: a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens, so the nuke never takes the +50% major (helm H7 precedent; pinned via fbMajorApplied). TRIGGER NOTE: in a comp where milk is the only B1 she casts every FB, so burstCast vs fullBurstEnter fire equal COUNTS — the spec discriminates by TIMING (fbMajor flag) instead. K6 (BUb, 'Recovers 16.16% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec'): burstCast → allies → heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 — a 10-SECOND WINDOW of recovery events, event-only by engine design (no HP amount modeled; the 16.16% magnitude rides in unmodeled, not fudged). Fires teammates' 'when recovery takes effect' consumers — the tandem channel (crown in the fixture; helm H8 precedent, same isolation pattern). INERT for milk's own damage in a comp without a recovery consumer (hard-rule-2 class: modeled for the event channel, not dropped as 'defensive' — S2b's tandem trap). K7 (BUc, 'Incoming healing ▲ 75.5% for 10 sec'): UNMODELED — no incoming-healing StatKey exists and heals carry no HP amount in v1, so the amplifier could only multiply event-less nothing; provably inert (verbatim in unmodeled.burst; S2b concurs). BURST-ELIGIBILITY: every modeled line except K1/K3 is burst/full-charge-gated — in a team that cannot chain B1→B2→B3 her kit contributes the S1 ATK buff + the passive crit damage and nothing else. NO `ignored` blocks.
